text: Assumption: Exceptions are propagated to the caller if construction fails — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: Exceptions are propagated to the caller if construction fails — is this correct?
norm: exceptions are propagated to the caller if construction fails
assumption: Exceptions are propagated to the caller if construction fails.
rationale: The specification designates the function as conditionally exception safe and ties noexcept to std::is_nothrow_constructible, but describes no module-specific error handling.

original.text: Annahme: Bei fehlschlagender Konstruktion werden Ausnahmen an den Aufrufer propagiert — trifft das zu?
